name: search
description: Search Mastodon for accounts, statuses, or hashtags. Returns matching profiles, posts, and tags with follower counts and engagement metrics.

type.description: Type of results: accounts, statuses, or hashtags (default: statuses)

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 40)

name: get_trending
description: Get currently trending posts on Mastodon. Returns popular statuses with engagement counts, authors, and trending tags.

limit.description: Number of trending statuses to return (default: 10, max: 40)

name: get_account
description: Get a Mastodon account profile by ID (e.g., '109382839472938472'). Returns bio, follower/following counts, post history, and verification status.

name: get_timeline
description: Get recent posts from the public Mastodon timeline. Returns statuses with authors, timestamps, engagement counts, and content.

limit.description: Number of statuses to return (default: 20, max: 40)
